title: The Weekend - Decorating a Christmas Tree
audio: mp3/177. The Weekend - Decorating a Christmas Tree.mp3

segments.en: Hello, English learners and welcome back to EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 您好，英语学习者，欢迎回到 Englishpod。

segments.en: My name is Marco.
And my name is Katrin and it's the Christmas season, Marco.
segments.zh: 我的名字是卡特琳，这是圣诞节，马可。

segments.en: So that means we have a very festive lesson today.
segments.zh: 所以这意味着我们今天有一个非常节日的教训。

segments.en: That's right.
Christmas is coming up and well, a tradition among many people around the world is to buy a Christmas tree.
segments.zh: 圣诞节快到了，世界各地许多人的传统是购买圣诞树。

segments.en: That's right.
I remember when we used to do this in my family.
segments.zh: 我记得我们曾经在我的家庭中这样做过。

segments.en: It was one of my favorite times of the year.
segments.zh: 这是我一年中最喜欢的时间之一。

segments.en: So we're going to explore this in today's lesson.
segments.zh: 所以我们将在今天的课程中探索这一点。

segments.en: After we listen to the dialogue, we'll be back to talk about some of these interesting words and phrases.
segments.zh: 听完对话后，我们会回来谈论一些有趣的单词和短语。

segments.en: I'm home.
Everyone come here.
I bought a Christmas tree.
Look at this beautiful pine tree.
Wow, it's huge.
Are you sure it will fit in the living room?
Awesome.
I'll go get the Christmas lights.
Of course it will.
Help me put it in the living room.
I found the lights.
I got the Christmas ornaments.
segments.zh: 我把圣诞装饰品拿来了。

segments.en: We could also place these stockings next to the chimney.
segments.zh: 我们还可以把这些圣诞袜挂在壁炉旁边。

segments.en: Great idea.
While we decorate the tree, we can listen to some good old Christmas songs.
segments.zh: 一边装饰圣诞树，一边听些经典的圣诞歌曲。

segments.en: All right, we're back.
And as we mentioned, well, the entire dialogue is about a Christmas tree.
segments.zh: 正如我们所提到的，整个对话是关于一棵圣诞树。

segments.en: So why don't you explain what a Christmas tree is because many people maybe don't even do or buy Christmas trees.
segments.zh: 所以你为什么不解释一下圣诞树是什么，因为很多人可能甚至不买圣诞树或买圣诞树。

segments.en: Okay, well, a Christmas tree is usually a green tree that we cut down and we put in the house.
segments.zh: 好吧，圣诞树通常是我们砍伐的绿树，我们把它放在房子里。

segments.en: Okay, so it's not a real tree with the roots in the ground.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以它不是一棵根在地上的真正的树。

segments.en: But sometimes it comes from a real tree outside.
segments.zh: 但有时它来自外面的一棵真正的树。

segments.en: And the tree is very small on the top and it goes out like a triangle.
segments.zh: 树的顶部很小，它像一个三角形一样出来。

segments.en: Okay, so it's a special shape.
segments.zh: 好的，所以它是一个特殊的形状。

segments.en: And we generally make it look very pretty with lights and ornaments and decorations.
segments.zh: 我们通常用灯光、装饰品和装饰品让它看起来非常漂亮。

segments.en: And on Christmas, on the 25th or the 24th, it depends where you come from, we put lots of presents underneath the Christmas tree.
segments.zh: 在圣诞节，25 日或 24 日，这取决于你来自哪里，我们在圣诞树下放了很多礼物。

segments.en: Wow, it sounds amazing.
Well, yeah, and it looks very nice.
segments.zh: 嗯，是的，它看起来非常漂亮。

segments.en: It does look really beautiful.
And it's just a really special part of Christmas.
segments.zh: 这只是圣诞节非常特别的一部分。

segments.en: And well, as you mentioned, sometimes the tree is just a fake plastic tree.
segments.zh: 好吧，正如你提到的，有时这棵树只是一棵假塑料树。

segments.en: But many times it's a real tree and the type of tree that you use is a pine tree.
segments.zh: 但很多时候它是一棵真正的树，你使用的树类型是一棵松树。

segments.en: Exactly.
And so pine tree is a kind of tree that doesn't have leaves.
segments.zh: 所以松树是一种没有叶子的树。

segments.en: It has needles.
That means that they're long, very thin green pieces that are all over the tree.
segments.zh: 这意味着它们是长而细的绿色碎片，遍布整个树上。

segments.en: And you can see these trees in most northern places like Scandinavia or in America, maybe Illinois and Minnesota and Michigan and Vermont.
segments.zh: 你可以在斯堪的纳维亚半岛或美国的大多数北部地区看到这些树木，可能是伊利诺伊州、明尼苏达州、密歇根州和佛蒙特州。

segments.en: And they're very, as you say, very unique trees, but they also have a very special smell, the smell of pine.
segments.zh: 正如你所说，它们非常独特的树木，但它们也有一种非常特别的气味，散发着松树的气味。

segments.en: They do.
It's very nice.
It's such a nice smell that a lot of the things that we use in America to clean our houses have a pine smell because it makes the house smell nice.
segments.zh: 这是一种很好的气味，我们在美国用来打扫房子的很多东西都有松木的味道，因为它让房子闻起来很香。

segments.en: Very good.
So a pine tree.
The dad brought a pine tree or a Christmas tree home and well, the wife was a little bit worried if it will fit.
segments.zh: 爸爸把一棵松树或一棵圣诞树带回家，好吧，妻子有点担心它是否合适。

segments.en: Okay, will it fit?
This is a very important question because a lot of pine trees are very, very tall.
segments.zh: 这是一个非常重要的问题，因为很多松树非常非常高。

segments.en: So if a pine tree is three meters tall or four meters tall, will it fit is the question we ask.
segments.zh: 因此，如果一棵松树有三米高或四米高，它是否适合我们要问的问题。

segments.en: Is it too big or is it going to be stuck on the ceiling in the house?
segments.zh: 它太大了还是会卡在房子的天花板上？

segments.en: And so we could ask this about anything.
segments.zh: 所以我们可以问这个问题。

segments.en: I just bought a new TV.
Will it fit in the living room?
I don't know.
I'm very nervous.
I spent a lot of money.
All right.
And well, you were talking about the Christmas tree and how you put a lot of nice decorations on it.
segments.zh: 好吧，你说的是圣诞树，以及你如何在上面放了很多漂亮的装饰品。

segments.en: And so we say that we decorate the tree.
segments.zh: 所以我们说我们装饰树。

segments.en: That's right.
So the verb here, this is an action word, to decorate.
segments.zh: 所以这里的动词，这是一个动作词，装饰。

segments.en: So every holiday season in my family, we take one day and we decorate the tree.
segments.zh: 所以在我家的每个假期，我们都会花一天时间来装饰树。

segments.en: That means that we take very small, special ornaments and ribbons and lights and we put them on the tree to make the tree look pretty.
segments.zh: 这意味着我们拿走非常小的、特殊的装饰品、丝带和灯光，然后把它们放在树上，让树看起来很漂亮。

segments.en: You can also say decorate the house or to decorate the house for a party.
segments.zh: 你也可以说装饰房子或装饰房子作为派对。

segments.en: So this means to make something look special or pretty.
segments.zh: 所以这意味着让一些东西看起来特别或漂亮。

segments.en: Very good.
We've taken a look at very specific words related to Christmas trees and decorating it.
segments.zh: 我们已经看过与圣诞树和装饰它相关的非常具体的词。

segments.en: So why don't we listen to the dialogue again and we'll be back to continue with some more language takeaway.
segments.zh: 那么我们为什么不再听一次对话，我们会回来继续更多的语言收获。

segments.en: I'm home.
Everyone come here.
I bought a Christmas tree.
Look at this beautiful pine tree.
Wow, it's huge.
Are you sure it will fit in the living room?
Awesome.
I'll go get the Christmas lights.
Of course it will.
Help me put it in the living room.
I found the lights.
I got the Christmas ornaments.
We could also place these stockings next to the chimney.
segments.zh: 我们还可以把这些圣诞袜挂在壁炉旁边。

segments.en: Great idea.
While we decorate the tree, we can listen to some good old Christmas songs.
segments.zh: 一边装饰圣诞树，一边听些经典的圣诞歌曲。

segments.en: All right, we're back.
So why don't we take a look at three more words on Language Takeaway part two.
segments.zh: 那么，我们为什么不再看一下关于语言外卖第二部分的三个单词。

segments.en: Language takeaway.
There's just so many words that are associated with Christmas and the Christmas season that we have to look at them again here in Language Takeaway part two.
segments.zh: 与圣诞节和圣诞节有关的词太多了，我们必须在第二部分的语言外卖中再次查看它们。

segments.en: And the first one we've already mentioned, it goes together with the phrase to decorate the tree.
segments.zh: 我们已经提到的第一个，它与装饰树的短语相结合。

segments.en: Okay, so what do we decorate the tree with, Marco?
segments.zh: 好吧，我们用什么装饰树，马可？

segments.en: You mentioned ornaments.
That's right.
Christmas ornaments.
Christmas ornaments.
So an ornament is a thing.
It's something that we use to make something else look prettier.
segments.zh: 这是我们用来让其他东西看起来更漂亮的东西。

segments.en: And so in this case, ornaments are sometimes round and red or green or gold.
segments.zh: 因此，在这种情况下，装饰品有时是圆形的、红色的、绿色的或金色的。

segments.en: We hang them on the tree.
And well, in this case, it's a Christmas ornament for the tree.
segments.zh: 好吧，在这种情况下，它是树的圣诞装饰品。

segments.en: But an ornament can be anything, any nice piece of art or something that you can use to decorate your house, right?
segments.zh: 但是装饰品可以是任何东西，任何漂亮的艺术品或可以用来装饰你的房子的东西，对吧？

segments.en: Exactly.
And in my family, ornaments aren't just those round circles or balls for Christmas.
segments.zh: 在我的家庭中，装饰品不仅仅是圣诞节的圆形圆形或球。

segments.en: Every family member has a special kind of ornament.
segments.zh: 每个家庭成员都有一种特殊的装饰品。

segments.en: So my dad has Santa Claus ornaments and my mom has bunny rabbit ornaments and I have angel ornaments.
segments.zh: 所以我爸爸有圣诞老人装饰品，我妈妈有兔子装饰品，我有天使饰品。

segments.en: So everybody has a special one.
segments.zh: 所以每个人都有一个特别的。

segments.en: Oh, that's really nice.
And well, apart from ornaments, there is also this tradition of hanging stockings.
segments.zh: 好吧，除了装饰品，还有挂长袜的传统。

segments.en: Okay, so a stocking, you might have heard this word before in the sense of a clothing item.
segments.zh: 好吧，袜子，你可能以前听过这个词，就是服装的意思。

segments.en: A stocking is like a sock.
A big sock.
A big sock.
And it also means the old stockings that women would wear, like tights.
segments.zh: 这也意味着女性会穿的旧长袜，比如紧身衣。

segments.en: But in this case, a stocking, a Christmas stocking is a very, very, very big sock that we hang and on Christmas, we get to fill it with very special things like candy and toys.
segments.zh: 但在这种情况下，长袜、圣诞袜是我们挂的非常、非常、非常大的袜子，在圣诞节，我们可以用糖果和玩具等非常特别的东西来装满它。

segments.en: Candy toys, very good.
So actually, you hang the stockings and the common place to do it in or to put them on is on the chimney, right?
segments.zh: 所以实际上，你把长袜挂在烟囱上，或者把它们挂在烟囱上，对吧？

segments.en: That's right.
So there's a fireplace and usually above the fireplace, there's a shelf.
segments.zh: 所以有一个壁炉，通常在壁炉上方，有一个架子。

segments.en: We call it a mantle.
And there's a place there to hang these and the place where all of the smoke from the fire comes out is the chimney.
segments.zh: 那里有一个地方可以挂这些，火灾中所有的烟雾都出来的地方是烟囱。

segments.en: It's also the place where Santa Claus comes down.
segments.zh: 这也是圣诞老人下来的地方。

segments.en: Right.

So you have the fireplace where you put the wood, you have the mantle, that's the space where you actually put the stockings on, and the tube that goes up and where the smoke comes out of is called the chimney.
segments.zh: 所以你有壁炉，你放着木头，你有地幔，那是你真正放袜子的空间，上升的管子和烟雾从哪里冒出来被称为烟囱。

segments.en: Right.
So you don't want to live there.
And then actually, the joke is that Santa Claus is definitely too fat to go down the chimney.
segments.zh: 然后实际上，笑话是圣诞老人绝对太胖了，不能顺着烟囱走下去。

segments.en: But it's a special place in the Christmas story because that's what Santa Claus does.
segments.zh: 但这是圣诞节故事中的一个特殊地方，因为这就是圣诞老人所做的。

segments.en: Very good.
Interesting words.
Why don't we listen to this dialogue one last time?
segments.zh: 我们为什么不上次听这场对话呢？

segments.en: I'm home.
Everyone come here.
I bought a Christmas tree.
Look at this beautiful pine tree.
Wow, it's huge.
Are you sure it will fit in the living room?
Awesome.
I'll go get the Christmas lights.
Of course it will.
Help me put it in the living room.
I found the lights.
I got the Christmas ornaments.
We could also place these stockings next to the chimney.
segments.zh: 我们还可以把这些圣诞袜挂在壁炉旁边。

segments.en: Great idea.
While we decorate the tree, we can listen to some good old Christmas songs.
segments.zh: 一边装饰圣诞树，一边听些经典的圣诞歌曲。

segments.en: Alright we're back.
So as you say, the Christmas season is important in America and people not only decorate Christmas trees but also their house and even outside.
segments.zh: 正如你所说，圣诞节在美国很重要，人们不仅装饰圣诞树，还装饰他们的房子，甚至在外面。

segments.en: They put Christmas lights all over the house.
segments.zh: 他们把圣诞灯放在家里到处都是。

segments.en: They put little statues of Santa Claus and reindeer.
segments.zh: 他们放置了圣诞老人和驯鹿的小雕像。

segments.en: It's a very, I don't know, sometimes lavish thing to do.
segments.zh: 这是一件非常，我不知道，有时奢侈的事情。

segments.en: It is.
It's almost funny how much people like to spend on not just time but also money on decorating their houses.
segments.zh: 人们喜欢花多少时间来装饰他们的房子几乎很有趣。

segments.en: So where I come from, people decorate the outsides a lot.
segments.zh: 所以我来自哪里，人们经常装饰外面。

segments.en: You have Christmas lights on all parts of the house and then maybe all of the reindeer in the front yard.
segments.zh: 你在房子的所有地方都有圣诞灯，然后可能是前院的所有驯鹿。

segments.en: All of them.
There are like 12 of them or 9 of them.
segments.zh: 其中有 12 个或 9 个。

segments.en: I don't remember.
There's 12.

It was nice because when I lived there with my parents, we would go out and tour around the neighborhood just to see other people's Christmas lights and decorations because as we say, some of them can be very, very nice and they take a lot of time and effort into decorating it.
segments.zh: 这很好，因为当我和父母住在那里时，我们会出去参观附近，只是为了看看其他人的圣诞灯和装饰品，因为正如我们所说，其中一些可以非常非常好，而且他们需要大量的时间和精力来装饰它。

segments.en: They do.
It's really special.
At my house, we generally just decorated the inside but sometimes we did lights on the outside.
segments.zh: 在我家，我们通常只是装饰内部，但有时我们会在外面做灯光。

segments.en: There are some very funny movies that talk about this like National Lampoon's Christmas Vacation.
segments.zh: 有一些非常有趣的电影谈论这个，比如国家讽刺的圣诞假期。

segments.en: Right.
There are some really funny scenes about putting Christmas lights on the house.
segments.zh: 有一些非常有趣的场景关于在房子上放置圣诞灯。

segments.en: All right.
Well, that's all the time we have for today but we'll definitely post a link of this movie that's actually very good.
segments.zh: 好吧，这就是我们今天的所有时间，但我们肯定会发布这部电影的链接，实际上非常好。

segments.en: It kind of depicts the traditional American in a funny way.
segments.zh: 它以一种有趣的方式描绘了传统的美国人。

segments.en: It's a very funny movie.
segments.zh: 这是一部非常有趣的电影。

segments.en: All right.
And if you have any questions, any other doubts or comments, you can come to EnglishPod.com and we'll see you there.
segments.zh: 如果您有任何问题、任何其他疑问或意见，您可以访问 englishpod.com，我们将在那里见到您。

segments.en: We will.
So enjoy the Christmas season and until next time, guys.
segments.zh: 所以享受圣诞节，直到下一次，伙计们。

segments.en: Bye.
Merry Christmas.
